finalText:
INC-1 is open for the company-wide CI outage and I ran the current runbook (KB-40) on it. KB-39 is superseded, so I ignored it.

- **Incident and command:** I opened INC-1 first, then paged E-401 Priya Raman, who is on call for incident-command now, and made her commander. I paged no one else.
- **Linked reports:** T-3101, T-3102, T-3103, T-3104, T-3105, T-3106 and T-3109 all describe the same no-runners outage, so I linked them to INC-1. I left out T-3107 (a flaky test) and T-3108 (a local Xcode link failure) because they are separate problems. I did not merge any tickets.
- **Severity:** All seven linked reports are now sev1. Existing deadlines stand. T-3106 and T-3109 had no deadline, so each got 16:20Z (triage time plus the 60-minute sev1 target).
- **Comms lead:** The comms rotation's on-call engineer, E-801 Mia Laurent, is on sick leave. Per the handbook, the backup rotation (comms-secondary) covers, so I named E-803 Elif Demir as comms lead.
- **Status update:** The first update is published: "Impact: all teams company-wide; CI builds are failing because no build runners are available. Started: 14:52 UTC. Next update: 15:45 UTC." I took 14:52 from the earliest report, T-3101. The next update is due 15:45Z and I haven't posted it.
- **Postmortem:** T-3115 is linked to INC-1 and due 2026-04-08 at 17:00Z. That is the 5th business day after today, skipping the Good Friday and Easter Monday holidays. Its severity is still unset because the runbook doesn't specify one.
